name: card-open
moment: a weight's card opens (reading a criterion)
prompt: A small solid brass weight lifted off a wooden rack and a thick paper card turned over on green felt, soft metal and paper

name: sheet
moment: the bake-off sheet opens (reading what is known)
prompt: A sheet of heavy parchment paper picked up from a desk and held, crisp rustle

name: place
moment: a weight is placed on your pan (the per-placement commit, final)
prompt: A heavy brass weight set down into a brass scale pan, bright metal clank, the pan chains rattling and the beam creaking as it tilts

name: lock
moment: Lock it confirmed: the scorecard is locked (the commit)
prompt: A heavy iron embossing seal press pulled down onto thick paper: the lever creaking, a deep crunching press, then the lever springing back up

name: strike
moment: reveal, wrong: a loaded criterion is struck off your pan onto the table
prompt: A heavy brass weight knocked off a metal scale pan, falling and clattering onto a wooden table top

name: unroll
prompt: A roll of stiff parchment unrolled across a wooden desk, dry paper crackle

name: take-us
moment: reveal, right: a criterion lands on your pan (you take it)
prompt: A brass weight dropped into a brass balance pan with a clear ringing clink, the pan swinging on its chains

name: take-them
moment: reveal, wrong: a criterion lands on their pan (they take it)
prompt: A heavy iron weight dropped onto a wooden board with a dull dead thud, no ring

name: take-even
moment: reveal: a split criterion is set on the rail at the fulcrum
prompt: A small brass weight set gently down on a brass rail, a light soft tap

name: result-won
moment: end: the beam settles your way (you take the bake-off)
prompt: A large brass balance scale beam swinging down and settling, a long warm metallic ring fading slowly

name: result-lost
moment: end: the beam drops their way or sits level (you do not take it)
prompt: A heavy brass scale beam dropping hard onto its iron stop, a flat heavy clunk and a short rattle of chains
